title: mod.yml: a mod's manifest (devdocs/map_studio/S6_PLAN.md item M), written by `oymap mod pack`
description: A mod is a folder: this manifest, the files it brings under engine/ and worlds/<world>/ as the game's packages hold them, and under tables/ the rows of engine tables it changes (<table>.override.txt: "key<TAB>column<TAB>value" with columns as #<index>, the rulesets' override format) and adds (<table>.append.txt, rows in the table's own layout). `oymap mod install` installs it into a game's mods folder: `merged` (the loose mods/engine and mods/worlds folders, which the game mounts in front of every named mod; tables composed from the game's own and every installed mod's rows) or `named` (mods/<id>/ and mods/enabled.yml, the game's named mods: devdocs/NAMED_MODS.md; the game composes their table rows itself and switches one off by its `mods disable <id>` console command, from its next start).

id.description: Lower case letters, digits and underscores: the folder's name in a named install.

worlds.description: The worlds whose maps it brings or changes.

maps.description: Its maps: a new map, or an overlay of a shipped one (its scene and script overlays).

file.description: The map file (a new map's, or the shipped map an overlay changes).

project.description: The Map Studio project it was built from (its id).

source_revision.description: The project's source revision the build was made from.

files.description: Its files in the mod, by path.

tables.description: Engine tables it changes, with the files of its rows.

map_numbers.description: The map_stats numbers its new maps take (another mod must not use them).

idRanges.description: The numbers the mod declares as its own, by domain, as a world's world.yml and a ruleset's ruleset.yml declare theirs ({begin, end}): `maps`, the map_stats numbers of its new maps. The studio proposes a new project of the mod the first free number of its range (mod.map_number) and warns of ranges that overlap the world's or another mod's.

maps.description: The map_stats numbers its new maps take.
